note: 40 scripted customer conversations for Toloka's human raters. Demo business, fictional (data/demo-business.json). Expected facts are hand-computed from the price sheet. Tiers: junior 0 to under 3 years, mid 3 to under 8, senior 8+, executive by title. Fields: tier/price_sar = the correct quote if one is given; must_state_price = a desk reply must state price_sar; handover/booking = true (must happen), false (must not), null (either is acceptable, see note); no_quote_call = the desk must ask instead of pricing; must_not_say = text that must not appear in any desk reply. Contacts use example.com (reserved, no real person).
